diagnosis.summary: The candidate uses a periodic `if` guard after the delay to detect the condition. F1 shows the input dropped to `null` at 900000ms, and F2 shows the IR performed `switch_off` while the JoI did nothing. The IR specifies a one-shot sequence (no `cycle`), so the `if` block must execute unconditionally at that instant, not be gated by a re-evaluated condition. The candidate incorrectly requires the temperature to still be >28 to turn off the fan, whereas the IR mandates the action regardless of the current sensor state after the fixed delay.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the conditional guard `if ((#Bedroom_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature > 28)` surrounding the `switch_off` call. The IR defines a linear sequence of actions; the turn-off is a fixed step 15 minutes after the turn-on, not dependent on the sensor reading at that moment.
